title: Formatted Founding Function
code: library(round2) x <- c(1.024, 1.110, 1.2) round2(x) #> [1] "1.02" "1.11" "1.20" round2(x, digits = 3) #> [1] "1.024" "1.110" "1.200" round2(x, digits = 4) #> [1] "1.0240" "1.1100" "1.2000" # verses the default round function when "pasting" to characters paste0(round(x)) #> [1] "1" "1" "1" paste0(round(x, digits = 2)) #> [1] "1.02" "1.11" "1.2" paste0(round(x, digits = 3)) #> [1] "1.024" "1.11"  "1.2" paste0(round(x, digits = 4)) #> [1] "1.024" "1.11"  "1.2"
